en.title: China gives rare high-level reception to former Foreign Minister Iwaya, seeks Taiwan policy shift from Takaichi administration
en.summary: Former Foreign Minister Iwaya held consecutive meetings in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Vice Premier He Lifeng. This marked the first high-level talks between Chinese leadership and a Japanese lawmaker since relations deteriorated over Taiwan-related remarks by Prime Minister Takaichi last November.

en.summary: President Trump praised his February 24 meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping as extremely successful, using his characteristic exaggerated rating scale. Trump denied reports that weapons sales to China were discussed during the meeting.

en.title: Fukuoka Prefectural Assemblyman Suspended for Inappropriate Posts on Anonymous Account Amid Money Transfer Allegations
en.summary: The Liberal Democratic Party's Fukuoka prefectural assembly delegation suspended assemblyman Hayashi Taisuke for five months after he repeatedly made inappropriate posts using an anonymous social media account related to money transfer allegations regarding leadership posts. Social media activity was also prohibited.
